Monte Carlo — where could the price go?: 50,000 paths, 16 forces: the gas-feedstock cost (the dominant swing), the EGP, global urea/ammonia prices, rates, inflation, foreign flows, dividend policy and gas-supply interruptions. Details in the methodology .
FAQ: What is the fair-value range for Juhayna Food Industries (JUFO)? — testahil publishes a probability distribution of where JUFO could trade over the next 1–3 months — the simulated 5th–95th percentile range and the central 50% — not a single price target or a buy/sell call. The full study and open model show the methodology. This is educational analysis, not investment advice.

How is the JUFO valuation calculated? — The study uses an instrument-appropriate lens — a going-concern discounted-cash-flow (FCFF) build for a branded food producer, cross-checked by relative multiples, normalized earnings and a segment sum — combined with a 50,000-path Monte Carlo simulation that expresses the result as a probability distribution. Every assumption is visible and editable in the free Excel model.
